info.name: Memory Photo - ordered end-to-end local checks
info.description: Run once, in order, against a dedicated local test database and a fresh student with zero lifetime submissions. Consumes three submissions and leaves Memory Photo disabled. Import the companion blank environment, supply local credentials privately, and set the working directory to the repository root for the bundled PNG. Tokens and IDs are chained in runtime-local variables; scripts never log credentials or save tokens to exported environment files. Read docs/memory-photo-postman-guide.md first. Expected negative requests are asserted as successes. Dedicated-role extension: supply a fresh memory_admin_username and private memory_admin_password. The full admin provisions it, then moderation uses memory_admin_token; settings remain full-admin-only. All credentials in the saved template remain blank. Final three-role integration adds successful full-admin contestant/gallery CRUD and private-image/settings access. Second photo rejection uses ADMIN, first approval and third rejection use MEMORY_ADMIN. Use an isolated database whose voting period has not started.
